reason: Add phase-specific guidance: a controlled descent bonus that rewards using main engine when near pad and upright, and a touchdown stability bonus that rewards low velocity when both legs contact. Tighten success condition to match evaluator: both legs contact, near pad (|x|<0.15, |y|<0.15), low vertical speed (|vy|<0.5). Remove raw main_engine_usage penalty and replace with conditioned bonus. Keep distance and angle shaping but reduce their scale slightly to avoid dominance.
preserved_design: progress_shaping (distance and angle penalties) but reduced scale
velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) but reduced scale
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
changed_design: Relax success condition: both legs contact, |x|<0.15, |y|<0.15, |vy|<0.5 (no vx constraint, no angle constraint) to align with evaluator success-like behavior.

Add controlled_descent_bonus: +0.5 per step when main engine is used (m_power>0) AND lander is near pad (x^2+y^2<0.5) AND angle is small (|angle|<0.2). This conditions engine use on progress and stability, not raw action.
Add touchdown_stability_bonus: +10 when both legs contact AND |vy|<0.5 AND |vx|<0.5 AND |angle|<0.2. This is a one-shot event-gated bonus for stable touchdown.
Reduce distance_penalty scale from -0.1 to -0.05 to reduce dominance.
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: instead, condition main engine bonus on progress and stability.
Do not only reduce distance shaping: we also add phase-specific bonuses and align success condition.
action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. The controlled_descent_bonus will encourage more main engine use (action 2) during descent, increasing its usage from 15% to >20%.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance and angle shaping guide the lander toward pad and upright. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus rewards using main engine when near pad and stable. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus rewards low velocity at contact. Success bonus provides final sparse signal.
payment_mode_plan: controlled_descent_bonus is a per-step conditioned bonus (not raw action), diminishing when not near pad or unstable. touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated. objective_success_bonus is one-shot event-gated. All other terms are per-step penalties.
